label: after
stuck_definition: Speed below 30cm/s with target above 150cm/s, or any continuous stop over 5s; commanded short yields separately counted as stationary time.
metric_definition: Pairwise order exchanges require +/-250 cm longitudinal clearance and 1s confirmation, counted after 5s. Collision episodes are per-kart starts of non-ground swept contacts, separated by 0.5s. Off-track episodes use projected collider half-extents and 0.3s confirmation. Player uses the existing opt-in AI diagnostic driver.
safety_failure: Stop before broader testing: contacts, sustained off-track or stuck time
